summary: Frontend-only testing (FASE B credit system UI). Verified: (1) /account CreditsSection for org admin qa.eventi@crmeventqa.it shows balance 120, 'I crediti non scadono', low-balance threshold, ledger with 'Accredito demo' row. (2) Recharge dialog opens with 6 packages, all 6 buy buttons DISABLED with label 'Non disponibile in preview', 'Contattaci' and 'Ricarica automatica — prossimamente' present. (3) Preexisting Account sections (fatturazione, piani per evento) still present without errors. (4) Super Admin /piattaforma/crediti loads with 3 tabs. (5) Servizi tab lists all 9 services (ai_analysis, ai_content, ai_briefing, image_generation, automation_run, newsletter_email, google_calendar, whatsapp_send, sms_send); saving a service shows toast 'Servizio ... aggiornato'. (6) Ricariche tab has 6 packages, total recomputes live on edit (100→110), save toast 'Taglio aggiornato'. (7) Organizzazioni tab: search org_qa_eventi shows balance 120, empty causale triggers 'La causale è obbligatoria', valid adjust (+5) registers movement, balance updates 120→125, restore -5 returns to 120. All data-testid selectors work as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: CreditsSection.jsx uses 'if (!bal) return null' which hides the whole section during initial load and also silently on error — consider a loading skeleton and explicit error state.
PlatformCredits.jsx OrgsTab: 'load' function shadows outer 'data' variable name with destructured 'const { data } = await api.get(...)'; works but slightly confusing.
Recharge buy buttons rely on visual 'disabled' — good; however the disabled state is not surfaced via aria-disabled attribute (already handled by shadcn Button).
seed_data_creation: Created and rolled back adjust movements (+5 then -5) on org_qa_eventi with note 'TEST rettifica QA' / 'TEST ripristino QA'. Final org balance restored to 120. Also modified one recharge package's credits_base (+10) and reverted to original value. Servizi save on ai_analysis was executed and version incremented (no revert performed — cost value unchanged from previous empty state).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All FASE B UI flows verified end-to-end on preview URL. No blockers. Note: Servizi tab 'unit_cost' was initially empty for ai_analysis; the save operation succeeded regardless. If needed, main agent can seed initial costs. Iubenda cookie banner accept selector works with locator 'Accetta'.
